body:
This PR changes the way we guard against having small negative numbers in our moisture tracers. 

In case when, for example, `q_liq` is a very small negative number:

 `microphysics_function(q_liq) = 0` . 

But we also limit for not overshooting the tendency due to too long time step by taking 

`tendency = min(q_liq/dt, microphysics_function(q_liq)`. 

In that case we would end up with a wrong, small negative tendency. To prevent that I now changed it to

`tendency = min(max(0.0, q_liq/dt), microphysics_function(q_liq)`. 

If you actually plot snow profiles, you will notice we have some very small snow values. This PR fixes it.
title: changes in guarding against small negatives, fixes snow profiles
